explanation.text:
ADVOKATFIRMAET SCHJØDT AS (org.nr 996 918 122) is registered as Aksjeselskap (AS), founded 2011-05-10, registered 2011-05-13. Business address: Tordenskiolds gate 12, 0160 OSLO. Main industry (NACE): 69.100 Juridisk tjenesteyting. Registered employees: 193 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 535,966,346; operating result NOK 315,293,571; net result NOK 341,517,737; total assets NOK 569,004,944; equity NOK 47,230,369 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 1,967,325,867). Leadership: board chair Erlend Brun Bakken; 9 other board members. Sub-units registered: 4. Website: www.schjodt.no. Wikipedia: https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/Advokatfirmaet_Schj%C3%B8dt.
